title: Tomato and coconut cassoulet

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.amount: a slosh, plus more to drizzle

ingredients.name: Fresh ginger
ingredients.amount: 1cm thick piece, the size of a 50p

instructions: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Wash, trim and roughly slice the leek, finely chop the garlic and the deseeded chilli, roughly chop the ginger, drain the beans and halve the fresh tomatoes.

Heat an ovenproof pan on a medium heat with a slosh of oil. Add the leek, garlic, chilli, ginger, a pinch of salt and some pepper, turn the heat down and cook for 10 minutes, until the leeks are soft and sweet.
Add the tinned tomatoes, coconut milk and beans and simmer for a couple of minutes. Take off the heat and check the seasoning.
Scatter over the fresh tomatoes, then the basil, then tear the bread into chunks and push them into the gaps so the top is a covering of tomatoes and bread.
Drizzle with olive oil and bake for 30 minutes, until the tomatoes have shrunk and sweetened and the bread is crisp and golden. Rest a few minutes and serve with a lemony green salad.
